name: Champagne Hillsides, Houses and Cellars
description: This World Heritage site spreads across the Champagne region of northeastern France, linking three places where sparkling wine took shape. You can walk among the steep vineyards around Hautvillers and Aÿ, visit the chalk cellars beneath Saint-Nicaise Hill in Reims, and stroll Épernay's Avenue de Champagne, lined with the grand houses that sold the wine to the world.
